ab_test.expectation: B is expected at -8..-4 RUB/trade against -15..-17 RUB for A, i.e. less negative and still negative. The +12.8 RUB/trade counterfactual comes from holding to 15 s, not from holding longer (60 s = -32.6 RUB). No number from this run means the strategy became profitable
